programs.title: Bamay
programs.sub_title: Jaru Country - Bungle Bungles WA Part 2
programs.desc: The filmmaker showcases the beautiful landscape of the Bungle Bungle Range in the Kimberley region of Western Australia which is home to the Jaru people.

programs.title: Toi Time
programs.desc: The Toi Time whanau learn that the sky is kahurangi, the grass is kikorangi and the sun is kowhai. Aunty Anika sings about nga tae o te uenuku - colours of the rainbow.

programs.title: Waabiny Time
programs.desc: Kwort Kwobikin, to celebrate is deadly! Moort madja, family get-togethers are deadly!

programs.title: Birds Eye View
programs.desc: There's a bird trapped inside a cage inside the human's house. Holy Heka! It's time to break that jailbird out.

programs.title: Aussie Bush Tales
programs.desc: Three mischievous Aboriginal boys and their cousin Jedda always followed by their dingo puppy Snowy, go exploring and investigate new and exciting mysteries in the Aussie Bush.

programs.title: The Mysterious Cities Of Gold
programs.desc: Zares and Laguerra capture the children and push them towards the exit, revealing that he possesses another way towards the fourth city of gold. They just need them and their medallions to open it.
